blurb: Seagull Outfitters is located on Seagull Lake at the end of the Gunflint Trail in northeastern Minnesota, offering direct access to the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness and Quetico Park. Guests can enjoy canoeing, fishing, hiking, swimming, exploring, and relaxing in a wilderness setting. The outfitter provides lodging in cabins or a bunkhouse and expert assistance in planning canoe trips, camping equipment, and menus.
